Message.Name: Seconds Message
Message.Description: This message is sent every second for which at least one TotalView-ITCH 3.2 message is being generated.

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Number of seconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Milliseconds Message
Message.Description: This message is sent every millisecond for which at least one TotalView-ITCH 3.2 message is being generated.

Field.Name: Millisecond
Field.Description: Number of milliseconds since last second.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: See System Event Codes.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, NASDAQ disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in the NASDAQ execution system.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the NASDAQ execution system. Refer to Appendix B for stock symbol convention information.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market or listing market tier for the issue.

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: For NASDAQ-listed issues, this field indicates when a firm is not in compliance with NASDAQ continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue.

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if NASDAQ system limits order entry for issue.

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: Indicates the current trading state for the stock.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Trading Action reason. For the list of reason codes, please refer to Appendix C.

Message.Name: Reg Sho Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: In association with the Reg SHO rule change, NASDAQ will introduce the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator message format. For NASDAQ-listed issues, NASDAQ will support a full pre-opening spin of Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator messages indicating the Rule 201 status for all active issues. NASDAQ will also send the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator message in the event of an intraday status change.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reg Sho Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: Market Participant Position Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, NASDAQ disseminates a spin of market participant position messages. Throughout the day, NASDAQ will send out this message only if NASDAQ Operations changes the status of a market participant firm in an issue.

Field.Name: Mpid
Field.Description: Denotes the market participant identifier for which the position message is being generated.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for which the position is being generated.

Field.Name: Primary Market Maker
Field.Description: Indicates if the market participant firm qualifies as a Primary Market Maker in accordance with NASDAQ marketplace rules.

Field.Name: Market Maker Mode
Field.Description: Indicates the quoting participant's registration status in relation to SEC Rules 101 and 104 of Regulation M.

Field.Name: Market Participant State
Field.Description: Indicates the market participant's current registration status in the issue.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that a new order has been accepted by the NASDAQ system and was added to the displayable book. The message includes a day-unique Order Reference Number used by NASDAQ to track the order. This message will be generated for unattributed orders in the NASDAQ execution system.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares associated with the order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: The security symbol for which the order is being added.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Message.Name: Add Order with Mpid Message
Message.Description: This message will be generated for attributed orders and quotations entered into the NASDAQ execution system.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares associated with the order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: The security symbol for which the order is being added.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Attribution
Field.Description: NASDAQ market participant identifier associated with the entered order.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The order reference number associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ generated day-unique Match Number of this execution. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Order Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ generated day-unique Match Number of this execution. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays and volume calculations.

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: The price at which the order execution occurred. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is modified as a result of a partial cancellation.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being canceled or reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares being removed from the display size of the order as the result of a cancellation.

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is being cancelled. All remaining shares are no longer accessible so the order should be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being canceled or reduced. References a previously sent Add Order Message.

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book has been cancel and replaced. All remaining shares from the original order are no longer accessible, and must be removed. The new order details are provided for the replacement, along with a new order reference number which will be used henceforth. The side, stock, and attribution (if any) remain the same as the original order, so they are not given in this message.

Field.Name: Original Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The original reference number of the order being replaced.

Field.Name: New Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The new reference number for this order. Note that new reference numbers mean new time priority, so this order belongs below other orders at the same price in priority.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The new total displayed quantity.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new display price for the order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: The Trade Message is designed to provide execution details for normal match events involving non-displayable order types.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the order on the book being executed. Effective December 6, 2010, NASDAQ OMX will populate the Order Reference Number field within the Trade (Non-Cross) message as zero. For the binary versions of the TotalView-ITCH data feeds, the field will be null-filled bytes (which encodes sequence of zero).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of non-display order on the book being matched. Effective 07/14/2014, this field will always be "B" regardless of the resting side.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares being matched in this execution.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: The security symbol associated with the match execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The match price of the order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ generated session-unique Match Number for this trade. The Match Number is referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Cross Trade Message
Message.Description: Cross Trade message indicates that NASDAQ has completed its cross process for a specific security.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares matched in the NASDAQ Cross.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: The security symbol associated with the cross trade message.

Field.Name: Cross Price
Field.Description: The price at which the cross occurred. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ generated day-unique Match Number of this execution.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The NASDAQ cross session for which the message is being generated.

Message.Name: Broken Trade Message
Message.Description: The Broken Trade Message is sent whenever an execution on NASDAQ is broken.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ Match Number of the execution that was broken. This refers to a Match Number from a previously transmitted Order Executed Message, Order Executed With Price Message, or Trade Message.

Message.Name: Net Order Imbalance Indicator Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ disseminates NOII data at 5-second intervals in the minutes leading up to the NASDAQ Opening Cross, NASDAQ Closing Cross and NASDAQ IPO/Halt Cross.

Field.Name: Paired Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares that are eligible to be matched at the Current Reference Price.

Field.Name: Imbalance Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares not paired at the Current Reference Price.

Field.Name: Imbalance Direction
Field.Description: The market side of the order imbalance.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: The security symbol for which the NOII message is being generated.

Field.Name: Far Price
Field.Description: A hypothetical auction-clearing price for cross orders only.

Field.Name: Near Price
Field.Description: A hypothetical auction-clearing price for cross orders as well as continuous orders.

Field.Name: Current Reference Price
Field.Description: The price at which the NOII shares are being calculated.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The type of NASDAQ cross for which the NOII message is being generated.

Field.Name: Price Variation Indicator
Field.Description: This field indicates the absolute value of the percentage of deviation of the Near Indicative Clearing Price to the nearest Current Reference Price.

Message.Name: Retail Price Improvement Indicator Message
Message.Description: Retail Price Interest Indicator (RPII), the Retail Interest message. Identifies a retail interest indication of the Bid, Ask or both the Bid and Ask for NASDAQ-listed securities.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the NASDAQ execution system. Refer to Appendix B for stock symbol convention information.

Field.Name: Interest Flag
Field.Description: Retail interest indication.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Outside of time stamp messages, the start of day message is the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System hours
Value.Description: This message indicates that NASDAQ is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System hours
Value.Description: It indicates that NASDAQ is now closed and will not accept any new orders today. It is still possible to receive Broken Trade messages and Order Delete messages after the End of Day.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Emergency Market Condition Halt
Value.Description: This message is sent to inform NASDAQ market participants that the EMC is in effect. No trading is allowed during the EMC.

Value.Name: Emergency Market Condition Quote Only Period
Value.Description: This message is sent to inform NASDAQ market participants that the EMC quotation only period is in effect.

Value.Name: Emergency Market Condition Resumption
Value.Description: This message is sent to inform NASDAQ market participants that EMC is no longer in effect.

Value.Name: In Compliance
Value.Description: Company is in compliance, if NASDAQ-listed issue. For NYSE, NYSE Amex and NYSE Arca issues, this field will also be space-filled.

Value.Name: Round Lots Only
Value.Description: Only round lots are accepted in this stock

Value.Name: Halted
Value.Description: Halted across all U.S. equity markets / SROs

Value.Name: Paused
Value.Description: Paused across all U.S. equity markets / SROs (NASDAQ-listed securities only)

Value.Name: Quotation Only Period
Value.Description: Quotation only period for cross-SRO halt or pause

Value.Name: Single Security Trading Pause In Effect
Value.Description: Single Security Trading Pause In Effect

Value.Name: Trading Halted For Information Requested By Listing Market
Value.Description: Trading Halted; For Information Requested by Listing Market

Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt – Level 3

Value.Name: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt Carry Over
Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt – Carry over from previous day

Value.Name: Single Security Trading Pause Quotation Only Period
Value.Description: Single Security Trading Pause / Quotation Only Period

Value.Name: Qualifications Issues Reviewed Resolved
Value.Description: Qualifications Issues Reviewed/Resolved; Quotations/Trading to Resume

Value.Name: Filing Requirements Satisfied Resolved
Value.Description: Filing Requirements Satisfied/Resolved; Quotations/Trading To Resume

Value.Name: Issuer News Not Forthcoming
Value.Description: Issuer News Not Forthcoming; Quotations/Trading To Resume

Value.Name: Qualifications Halt Ended
Value.Description: Qualifications Halt ended; Maintenance Requirements Met; Resume

Value.Name: Qualifications Halt Concluded
Value.Description: Qualifications Halt Concluded; Filings Met; Quotes/Trades To Resume

Value.Name: Trade Halt Concluded By Other Regulatory Authority
Value.Description: Trade Halt Concluded By Other Regulatory Auth.; Quotes/Trades Resume

Value.Name: Ipo Security Released For Quotation
Value.Description: IPO Security Released for Quotation (NASDAQ Securities Only)

Value.Name: Ipo Security Positioning Window Extension
Value.Description: IPO Security — Positioning Window Extension (NASDAQ Securities Only)

Value.Name: Restriction In Effect
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction in effect due to an intra-day price drop in security

Value.Name: Restriction Remains In Effect
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction remains in effect

Value.Name: Ipo And Halted Cross
Value.Description: Cross for IPO and halted / paused securities

Value.Name: Cross Network
Value.Description: NASDAQ Cross Network: Intraday Cross and Post-Close Cross. Cross Trade Message only.
